title: Paper Cans and Paper Tube Packaging Supplier Comparison Checklist
legal_name: Shenzhen Muge Design Packaging Product Co., Ltd.

supplier_comparison_checklist.buyer_should_confirm: Inside diameter, outside diameter, height and tolerance requirement.
supplier_comparison_checklist.why_it_matters: Small dimension changes can affect product fit, lid tension, insert design and shipping carton planning.

supplier_comparison_checklist.buyer_should_confirm: Paper cap, metal cap, plastic cap, shoulder-style cap or custom insert.
supplier_comparison_checklist.why_it_matters: The closure influences perceived value, protection, cost and recyclability discussions.

supplier_comparison_checklist.buyer_should_confirm: Kraft paper, printed paper wrap, composite board, liner options and wall thickness range.
supplier_comparison_checklist.why_it_matters: Structure strength and finish quality depend on more than the surface artwork.

supplier_comparison_checklist.buyer_should_confirm: Full-color print, kraft look, foil stamping, embossing, spot UV, matte or soft-touch lamination.
supplier_comparison_checklist.why_it_matters: Finish selection should match the product price point and the brand's retail environment.

supplier_comparison_checklist.buyer_should_confirm: Need for inserts, padding, inner bags, dust protection or shipping cartons.
supplier_comparison_checklist.why_it_matters: Paper tube packaging may be the retail package, secondary package or part of a larger shipper system.

supplier_comparison_checklist.buyer_should_confirm: Whether the supplier can review structure and artwork before a physical sample.
supplier_comparison_checklist.why_it_matters: Buyers should confirm fit, color, closure feel and print alignment before bulk production.

supplier_comparison_checklist.buyer_should_confirm: Commercial invoice, packing list and other project-specific documents available on request.
supplier_comparison_checklist.why_it_matters: Clear documentation reduces friction for international buyers and freight forwarders.

rfq_fields: Product type and approximate product dimensions
Quantity target and expected launch or reorder plan
Closure style, insert needs and protection concerns
Destination market and any required label or documentation review
iso_reference: MUGE PACKAGING is ISO 9001:2015 certified for the production of packaging products, including paper boxes, plastic pouches and plastic boxes, subject to certificate scope and validity.
